answer: Behind every lagoon there is a workshop, behind every delta a ledger, behind every cipher a calendar, and the farm has visited none of the three. The firmest wall I know is Enamel kilnman cobalt enamel plaque proof enamelled onto the colourists bench, and its bricks are each cobalt enamel plaque is a season of logged enamel firings plus a signed kiln. One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. Trust is sold per proof at 179 POA, and the farm's 353 proofs lock up 63187 POA it never sees again if it cheats.
